title: Reverse Proxies, Load Balancing & Nginx Architecture
subtopicTitle: Reverse Proxies, Load Balancing & Nginx Architecture
problemStatement:
Nginx event-driven architecture, reverse proxying, SSL termination, and load balancing algorithms (Round Robin, Least Connections, IP Hash).

**Architectural Importance**:
Reverse proxies sit at the front door of all production web infrastructures, protecting origin servers, terminating TLS, and distributing traffic.
interviewTrap: Confusing a Forward Proxy (protects and anonymizes the client) with a Reverse Proxy (protects, caches, and load-balances the backend servers).

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Client connects to Reverse Proxy (Nginx / HAProxy / Cloudflare) -> Proxy terminates TLS, compresses responses, and forwards request via internal VPC to an upstream pool of application instances.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Ingress & Routing: Client request hits edge network / reverse proxy / load balancer.
2. Application Core: Service logic processes request following Reverse Proxies, Load Balancing & Nginx Architecture patterns.
3. Data & Consistency: Data persistence / caching layer guarantees durability and low latency.
4. Failure Mitigation: Circuit breaking and graceful fallback prevent cascading outages.
